n = int(input().strip())
s = input().strip()
chars = list(s)
vals = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))

class Char:
    def __init__(self, chr, val, idx):
        self.chr = chr
        self.val = val
        self.idx = idx

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Char(chr={self.chr}, val={self.val}, idx={self.idx})"

def swap(i):
    chars[i], chars[n - i - 1] = chars[n - i - 1], chars[i]
    vals[i], vals[n - i - 1] = vals[n - i - 1], vals[i]

def is_anti_palindrome(chars):
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]:
            return False
    return True

wrong_chars = []
chars1 = []

for i in range(n // 2):
    if vals[i] > vals[n - i - 1]:
        swap(i)
    chr_obj = Char(chars[i], vals[i], i)
    if chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]:
        wrong_chars.append(chr_obj)
    chars1.append(chr_obj)

chars1.sort(key=lambda c: c.val)

diff = 0
if not is_anti_palindrome(chars):
    if len(wrong_chars) == 1:
        wrong_char = wrong_chars[0]
        for i in range(n // 2):
            chr_obj = chars1[i]
            if chr_obj.chr != wrong_char.chr and chars[n - chr_obj.idx - 1] != wrong_char.chr:
                diff = wrong_char.val + chr_obj.val
                break
    elif len(wrong_chars) > 1:
        from collections import Counter
        count_map = Counter([wc.chr for wc in wrong_chars])
        max_char, max_count = count_map.most_common(1)[0]
        append = []
        while max_count * 2 > len(wrong_chars) + len(append):
            for chr_obj in chars1:
                if (chr_obj.chr != max_char and 
                    chars[n - chr_obj.idx - 1] != max_char and 
                    chr_obj not in wrong_chars and 
                    chr_obj not in append):
                    append.append(chr_obj)
                    break
        diff = sum(wc.val for wc in wrong_chars) + sum(ac.val for ac in append)

total_sum = sum(vals)
print(total_sum - diff)
